text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a list of features and user stories describing what users need. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to adapt quickly to changes and deliver working results regularly. Agile values teamwork, flexibility and customer feedback over rigid planning.
